import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
T = chr(9)
FAKE = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, sys
a = sys.argv
prompt, model = a[a.index('-p') + 1], a[a.index('--model') + 1]
with open(os.environ['FAKE_LOG'], 'a') as h:
    h.write(json.dumps({'model': model, 'prompt': prompt, 'cwd': os.getcwd()}) + chr(10))
cases = {'T-043': ('A', 'scripts/verification_record.py:33 marker pattern lacks re.M'), 'T-042': ('B', 'scripts/execution_runner.py:75 git read lacks --no-replace-objects'), 'T-044': ('C', 'scripts/ledger.py:40 SENSITIVE_PATH lost the ~name/ alternative')}
cid, text = [v for k, v in cases.items() if k in prompt][0]
miss = model + ':' + cid in os.environ.get('FAKE_MISS', '').split(',')
v = 'PASS' if miss else 'FAIL'
body = {'run_ids': [], 'commits': [{'commit': 'HEAD', 'verdict': v, 'evidence': ['git show HEAD']}], 'findings': [] if miss else [{'id': 'F1', 'severity': 'blocking', 'text': text}], 'verdict': v}
print(json.dumps({'type': 'system'}))
print(json.dumps({'type': 'result', 'result': json.dumps(body)}))
'''
SEATS = {'rev_grok': ('fake-grok', 'grok'), 'rev.argon': ('fake-argon', 'argon'), 'rev.opus': ('fake-opus', 'opus')}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    t = Path(tmp)
    (t / 'bin').mkdir()
    (t / 'bin' / 'claude').write_text(FAKE)
    (t / 'bin' / 'claude').chmod(0o755)
    fleet = {'seats': {n: {'provider': 'claude', 'model': m, 'effort': 'medium', 'speed': 'unknown', 'family': f} for n, (m, f) in SEATS.items()}}
    (t / 'fleet.json').write_text(json.dumps(fleet))
    def run(seats, miss, tag, extra=()):
        log = t / (tag + '.log')
        env = dict(os.environ, PATH=str(t / 'bin') + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'], FAKE_LOG=str(log), FAKE_MISS=miss, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
        argv = [sys.executable, 'scripts/replay_seeded_defects.py', '--fleet', str(t / 'fleet.json'), '--out', str(t / tag), '--timeout', '120'] + list(extra)
        for s in seats:
            argv += ['--seat', s]
        r = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        calls = [json.loads(x) for x in log.read_text().splitlines()] if log.exists() else []
        return r, r.stdout.splitlines(), calls
    def row(*cols):
        return T.join(cols)
    r, out, calls = run(list(SEATS), 'fake-opus:A', 'one')
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-2000:] + r.stdout
    assert out[0] == row('seat', 'family', 'case', 'required', 'caught') and out[-1] == row('result', 'pass') and len(out) == 11, out
    assert row('rev.opus', 'opus', 'A', 'no', 'no') in out and row('rev_grok', 'grok', 'B', 'yes', 'yes') in out and row('rev.argon', 'argon', 'C', 'yes', 'yes') in out, out
    assert len(calls) == 9 and sorted(os.listdir(t / 'one')) == sorted(s + '-' + c + '.out' for s in SEATS for c in 'ABC'), calls
    for c in calls:
        p = c['prompt']
        assert '## Budget' in p and '400000 tokens' in p and 'explorer subagent' in p and 'schemas/review-verdict.schema.json' in p, p
        assert not [w for w in ('seeded', 'planted', 'calibration') if w in p.lower()], p
        assert Path(c['cwd']).resolve() != Path.cwd().resolve(), c
    r, out, _ = run(['rev_grok', 'rev.argon'], 'fake-grok:B', 'two')
    assert r.returncode == 1 and row('rev_grok', 'grok', 'B', 'yes', 'no') in out and out[-1] == row('result', 'fail'), out
    r, out, _ = run(['rev.opus'], '', 'three')
    assert r.returncode == 1 and row('missing', 'argon') in out and row('missing', 'grok') in out and out[-1] == row('result', 'fail'), out
    gonly = t / 'grok-only.jsonl'
    gonly.write_text(json.dumps({'type': 'seeded-calibration', 'reviewer': 'grok-4.7-high', 'case': 'A', 'task': 'T-043', 'commit': '53fb0f5', 'caught': True}) + chr(10))
    r, out, _ = run(['rev_grok'], 'fake-grok:B', 'six', ['--routing-data', str(gonly)])
    assert r.returncode == 0 and row('rev_grok', 'grok', 'A', 'yes', 'yes') in out and row('rev_grok', 'grok', 'B', 'no', 'no') in out and out[-1] == row('result', 'pass'), out
    r, out, calls = run(['nosuch'], '', 'four')
    assert (r.returncode, out, calls) == (2, [], []) and r.stderr.startswith('replay_seeded_defects: '), r
    r, out, calls = run([], '', 'five')
    assert r.returncode == 2 and calls == [], r
own = json.load(open('harness-manifest.json'))['ownership']
assert [own[k].count('scripts/replay_seeded_defects.py') for k in ('install_payload_paths', 'update_paths')] == [1, 1], 'manifest'
src = open('scripts/replay_seeded_defects.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'routing-data.jsonl' not in src and 'REQUIRED_2A' in src, 'the replay must default to the frozen 2A fixture'
print('ok')
